prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are a business analyst preparing a weekly management briefing for non-technical stakeholders.
Create an executive summary from the provided performance data using clear, concise language.
Your summary must emphasize decision-making implications, not technical details.
checklist: Report the top three findings with business impact.
Highlight one important risk and explain why it matters.
Compare current week vs previous week using concrete metrics.
Keep the final summary short, practical, and ready for leadership review.

events.content: Analyzing weekly KPI dataset and trend deltas...
Overall business performance improved this week, driven by stronger revenue and conversion efficiency.
Primary risk: refund rate increased from 1.6% to 2.1%, which may reduce net margin if the trend continues.
